title: Chat Assistant V1
subtitle: Your knowledge. Your own AI.
art: A beautiful alert tawny owl beside an open cream-paged reference book, a few neatly arranged knowledge documents and mossy roots. Fine golden filaments connect the book and documents to the glowing logo egg in its twig nest. Quiet emerald forest foliage and warm ivory paper contrast with amber light. The owl represents knowledge, without obscuring the title or egg.
prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: isolated 3D software product box cover for a Dutch nature-and-technology brand, AITJE. Square 1:1 canvas with real transparent background.

Entire box fits comfortably within the square canvas with modest transparent margins, no crop. Front face stays flat with straight print geometry and sharp typesetting. Top brand area approximately one fifth of the front. Big black bold modern sans-serif product title below the exact black AITJE logo. One short English subtitle. Lower artwork unique to this product and fills the face edge-to-edge. Small English footer clearly spaced, no dense technical list. Spine repeats AITJE and the product title in black. Soft realistic box shading, no outer scenery or backdrop, no large cast shadow.

This is an embossed warm glowing logo egg, not a plain egg with a thin equatorial orbit, and not a sticker or flat gold logo. Put this exact recognizable egg prominently in the lower artwork. Its glow lights the surrounding nest/moss naturally.
